title: Safer updates and private foundations
notes: Fixed: Update verification now works correctly on Android 8 and 8.1.
Improved: Update downloads use stronger version, size, package, checksum, and signing checks.
Improved: The Update centre highlights when a newer build is available.
Privacy: Android backup is limited to the offline planner and approved preferences.
Privacy: Account-storage safeguards are prepared internally; accounts and cloud sync remain unavailable in this build.
